text: On October 25, 2017, the City received a Zoning By-law Amendment application for the lands municipally known as 33-43 Centre Avenue (the "Site") to permit the construction of 16 single detached dwellings. The applicant appealed City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on its application for the Zoning By-law Amendment (the "Zoning Application"), to the Ontario Land Tribunal in March 2018. In December 2020, the applicant revised its Zoning By-law Amendment application and made a related Official Plan Amendment application (the "OPA Application") to permit the construction of 86 units in townhouse and low-rise apartment blocks, which was also appealed to the Ontario Land Tribunal.
